CEL-9 "Customer can export order history to CSV" has no linked cases and no similar case in the project. Plan: 2 new manual cases in Celestial Web Tests under Test Cases/Orders. "Export order history to CSV downloads a file" (main flow, medium priority). "Export order history with no orders shows an empty file message" (failure path, medium priority). Both link to CEL-9. Create them?

test_case.name: Export order history to CSV downloads a file
test_case.description: Checks that export order history to csv downloads a file.
test_case.preCondition: A customer with at least one past order is signed in.

steps.name: Open Order history and choose Export CSV

context.expectedResult: A CSV file with all orders downloads

test_case.name: Export order history with no orders shows an empty file message
test_case.description: Checks that export order history with no orders shows an empty file message.
test_case.preCondition: A customer with at least one past order is signed in.

steps.name: Open Order history for an account with no orders and choose Export CSV

context.expectedResult: A message says there are no orders to export
